overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Dehydrated Green Chili Powder for B2B food manufacturing and export requirements. It is made from selected green chilies and processed through cleaning, sorting, controlled drying, grinding, sieving, quality inspection, and packing. The result is a fine, free-flowing powder suited for bulk production, OEM supply, and private label programs.

The powder is available in a 60–80 mesh range with moisture at ≤ 8% and a shelf life of 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture. TradeNest Naturals supports custom mesh and packaging on request, with small-order flexibility starting from 5 Kg. Export documentation support is available for commercial shipments.
highlights: Dehydrated form for stable bulk use
